title: Roads in the Kingdom
statementMd:
In the Kingdom K., there are $*n*$ towns numbered with integers from $1$ to $*n*$. The towns are connected by $*n*$ bi-directional roads numbered with integers from $1$ to $*n*$. The $*i*$-th road connects the towns $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ and its length is $*l*_{*i*}$. There is no more than one road between two towns. Also, there are no roads that connect the towns with itself.

Let's call the inconvenience of the roads the maximum of the shortest distances between all pairs of towns.

Because of lack of money, it was decided to close down one of the roads so that after its removal it is still possible to reach any town from any other. You have to find the minimum possible inconvenience of the roads after closing down one of the roads.

## Input

The first line contains the integer $*n*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the number of towns and roads.

The next $*n*$ lines contain the roads description. The $*i*$-th from these lines contains three integers $*u*_{*i*}$, $*v*_{*i*}$, $*l*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$, $1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) — the numbers of towns connected by the $*i*$-th road and the length of the $*i*$-th road. No road connects a town to itself, no two roads connect the same towns.

*It's guaranteed that it's always possible to close down one of the roads so that all the towns are still reachable from each other.*

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum possible inconvenience of the roads after the refusal from one of the roads.
statementZhMd:
在 K. 王国中，有 $*n*$ 个城镇，编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。这些城镇由 $*n*$ 条双向道路连接，道路编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。第 $*i*$ 条道路连接城镇 $*u*_{*i*}$ 和 $*v*_{*i*}$，长度为 $*l*_{*i*}$。任意两个城镇之间至多有一条道路。此外，不存在连接城镇自身的道路。

我们将所有城镇对之间最短距离的最大值称为道路网络的不便度。

由于资金不足，决定关闭其中一条道路，并且关闭后仍需保证任意城镇之间都可以相互到达。请你求出关闭一条道路后，道路网络可能达到的最小不便度。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）——城镇和道路的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述道路。第 $*i*$ 行包含三个整数 $*u*_{*i*}$、$*v*_{*i*}$、$*l*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i*}, *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$，$1 ≤ *l*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）——第 $*i*$ 条道路连接的城镇编号以及该道路的长度。不存在连接城镇自身的道路，也不存在连接同一对城镇的多条道路。

*保证总能关闭其中一条道路，使得所有城镇仍然可以相互到达。*

## 输出格式

输出一个整数——关闭一条道路后，道路网络可能达到的最小不便度。
